capabilities: Plan tasks on a compact monthly calendar in the sidebar
Create one-off tasks with times, priorities, and per-occurrence notes
Set recurrence with daily, weekly, monthly, weekday, or custom intervals
Complete, edit, move, reorder, and delete tasks from task cards
Reflect task edits synced from other devices without restarting
extras: The plugin id remains 'daytask', so its data folder name differs from the AgendaPane display name; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Tasks live in .obsidian/plugins/daytask/data.json, so multi-device use depends on the user's sync solution covering hidden files.
problem: Task and scheduling plugins typically tie tasks to daily notes or files scattered across the vault, which users who want lightweight scheduling may not want.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Sync: enable Vault configuration sync and Community plugins for the same remote vault on desktop and mobile.

summary: Sidebar calendar and task pane that stores one-off and recurring tasks in plugin data without creating or modifying Markdown notes.
